title: Is Bitcoin a Buy at $63,000? We Asked 3 AI Models
excerpt: ChatGPT, Claude, and Grok all called Bitcoin a buy at current prices, but not one of them would say the bottom is in, and their worst-case targets reveal a s...

Quick Read

  • ChatGPT, Claude and Grok all called Bitcoin a buy at $63,90 for long-term holders but refused to name it the cycle bottom.

  • Downside targets range from ChatGPT's $45,000 to Claude's $30,000, which would match a repeat of the brutal 2022 bear market.

  • Bitcoin ETFs are still $4.5 billion in net outflows for 2026, and all three models named institutional buyers not returning as the biggest recovery risk.

  • The most widely read finance newsletter on Substack isn't published by a bank, it's Doomberg, where 383,000+ readers get the energy and macro analysis the mainstream press misses. 24/7 Wall St. readers save 17% on their first year here.

Bitcoin (CRYPTO:BTC) has traded between $63,000 and $65,000 since early July, which is the longest it has stayed still all year. The Bitcoin price has stopped falling, which is why people are asking whether the bottom is in.

So we asked ChatGPT, Claude and Grok whether Bitcoin is a buy at $63,900, and where they think BTC might bottom.

The AI Models Agree Bitcoin Is a Buy at $63,900

The three AI models called the Bitcoin price a buy for long-term holders. However, they refused to call buying at the current price a low-risk trade. ChatGPT argued the risk and reward are better at $63,900 than they were at $100,000 or $126,000, since Bitcoin only needs to reach its all-time high of $126,000 to double your money. 

The AI model also noted that Bitcoin has not rallied even with US stocks near record highs, which usually means buyers are staying away. However, ChatGPT sees it differently, because the ETFs still hold hundreds of thousands of Bitcoin even with inflows drying up, so the institutional buyers have not left.

They take no advertisers and serve no institution — which is why their lateral-thinking coverage of energy, finance, and geopolitics reads nothing like consensus financial media. Doomberg has set aside a discounted rate exclusively for 24/7 Wall St. readers — it isn't available on their main page.

Meanwhile, Claude looked at what caused Bitcoin's 50% drop from its October 2025 peak. PCE inflation hit 4.1% in June, which ended hopes of rate cuts and sent money into AI stocks instead. ETF inflows have also shrunk all year, and traders holding Bitcoin on leverage were forced to sell as prices fell, which pushed the Bitcoin price down further. So Claude sees this as a normal market cycle, since nothing catastrophic has hit the market this time, unlike the U.S. and Iran conflict that added selling pressure back in February.

自 7 月初以来，比特币（CRYPTO：BTC）的交易价格一直在 63,000 美元至 65,000 美元之间，这是全年保持静止状态的最长时间。 比特币价格已经停止下跌，这就是为什么人们在问底部是否已经到来。

因此，我们询问 ChatGPT、Claude 和 Grok 是否可以在 63,900 美元的价格买入比特币，以及他们认为 BTC 可能触底的位置。

AI 模型一致认为比特币价格为 63,900 美元

这三种人工智能模型将比特币价格称为长期持有者的买入价格。 然而，他们拒绝称以当前价格购买是低风险交易。 ChatGPT 认为 63,900 美元的风险和回报比 100,000 美元或 126,000 美元更好，因为比特币只需达到 126,000 美元的历史最高点即可使你的资金翻倍。

人工智能模型还指出，即使美国股市接近历史高点，比特币也没有上涨，这通常意味着买家正在远离。 然而，ChatGPT 却有不同的看法，因为即使资金流入枯竭，ETF 仍然持有数十万比特币，因此机构买家并没有离开。

在杜姆伯格发表言论之前，其团队在重工业、私募股权和硬科学领域度过了漫长的职业生涯。 他们不接受广告商，也不为任何机构服务——这就是为什么他们对能源、金融和地缘政治的横向思维报道读起来与共识金融媒体完全不同。 Doomberg 专门为 24/7 Wall St. 读者提供折扣价——在他们的主页上没有提供。

索取 24/7 华尔街房价 →

与此同时，克劳德研究了比特币较 2025 年 10 月峰值下跌 50% 的原因。 6 月份 PCE 通胀率达到 4.1%，降息的希望破灭，资金转而流入人工智能股。 全年ETF流入量也有所缩减，持有杠杆的比特币交易者因价格下跌而被迫抛售，从而进一步推低比特币价格。 因此，克劳德认为这是一个正常的市场周期，因为这次市场没有发生任何灾难性事件，不像二月份美国和伊朗冲突加剧了抛售压力。
